# dottype

> Generate C# types from JSON, JSON Lines, CSV, or Parquet using the dottype CLI or the dottype.Build NuGet package.

Start with the usage reference for dottype and dottype.Build version 0.3.0. It covers the shared argument contract and the differences between the CLI, single-file apps, project properties, and Visual Studio. There is no public runtime inference API.

## Documentation

- [Usage reference](USAGE.md): Installation, all arguments and defaults, CLI tab completion setup, equivalent examples, sampling, IntelliSense, and troubleshooting.
- [Quick start](README.md): Read an inventory CSV, query typed rows with LINQ, and try the CLI with a one-shot command.
- [CSV import](USAGE.md#read-a-csv-with-csvhelper): CsvHelper maps, exact header matching, and per-column type overrides.
- [JSON Lines](USAGE.md#read-json-lines): Sample newline-delimited objects from a file, a compressed export, or stdin.
- [Multiple models in one project](USAGE.md#multiple-models-in-one-project): Set options per example and use generated child types.

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/DouglasCleghorn/dottype): Source, examples, changelog, and repository instructions for contributors.
